segments.sn45.162:1.5: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ vidhānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
segments.sn45.162:1.7: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ … pe …
segments.sn45.162:1.8: imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave tissannaṃ vidhānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.

lines: Seyyohamasmīti vidhāti ahamasmi seyyoti evaṃ mānakoṭṭhāso mānaṭhapanā vā.
Vacanattho panettha yassa uppajjanti, taṃ purisaṃ nīhanantīti nīghā.
162-171. Seyyohamasmītiādinā taṃtaṃvibhāgena dhīyanti vidhīyantīti vidhā, mānakoṭṭhāsā, mānaṭṭhapanā vā.
